teaser: You set down one bag and reach for another that isn't yours to carry — the shape of a life path 6 crossed with an ENFP. The 6 asks you to tend whoever is near, to build a home even in passing places; the ENFP turns that tending into a dozen bright threads rather than one steady rope. What's particular here is the whiplash between devotion and distraction: falling hard for the work of caring for someone, then itching toward the next idea before the first has settled. Both are true at once.
